scope.summary: Implement the `layout` command family over StudioLayoutGrid/StudioConstraint/StudioAutoLayout: layout grids, auto-layout, constraints, anchored objects. Consumes foundation LayoutEngine (MT-020); deduped from layout-grid/auto-layout/constraint source DOMs into ONE family. Dry-run/receipt/undo/promotion.
acceptance_criteria: layout family on one contract over LayoutEngine; deduped; dry-run/undo/promotion
proof_targets: layout family runtime test via LayoutEngine
expected_tests: live: layout.set_auto_layout dry-run + promote + undo (reflow observable)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No layout automation on the unified contract.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
